title: Quantity
summary: A number field with «−» and «+»: a WAI-ARIA spinbutton with bounds, a step and digits, strict typing in the page's language, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End, a held stepper repeats; label, help, error, required, disabled, read-only, the three field sizes and the inherited value as every field has them.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

name.description: The form name: a hidden input submits the value with a point and no grouping (`2567.50`), whatever the box shows. The box itself has no name.

label.description: The field label above the box; it names the spinbutton. Slot `label` takes markup instead.

hint.description: Help text under the field; slot `hint` takes markup instead.

min.description: The lower bound: «−» is disabled on it, Home goes to it, a typed value below it is raised to it on commit. Empty for none; with none, or one below zero, a minus sign may be typed.

max.description: The upper bound: «+» is disabled on it, End goes to it, a typed value above it is lowered to it on commit. Empty for none.

step.description: How far «−», «+», ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the value. A positive number; anything else is 1. Its decimals are the field's digits unless `precision` says otherwise.

page-step.description: How far PageUp and PageDown move the value; ten steps when empty.

precision.description: Digits after the decimal mark, shown and kept; empty takes them from `step` (0.25 has two). With none, a decimal mark cannot be typed.

grouping.description: Group thousands the page's language's way («2 567»); `grouping="false"` writes the digits together, for a year or a code.

steppers.description: The look (owner decision C53): `sides` puts «−» and «+» on both sides of the number, for a quantity changed by a few steps (a cart line, guests, records per page); `none` is a plain number field for an exact value (a year, a weight, a price) -- the arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End still step.

unit.description: A unit written after the number, inside the box, in the quiet ink («кг», «%», «₽»); the spinbutton says it with the value («2,5 кг»).

digits.description: How many characters the number place holds. Empty: the longest of min, max, the value and the inherited value at the field's decimals, at least 2, and 6 with no max. A column of fields gives each the same number so the column is straight.

locale.description: The language the number is read and written in; unset, the page's (`lang`), so the decimal mark is a comma on a Russian page.

size.description: Field size: 1/2, 1 or 2, as every form field.

required.description: The field must hold a number: the box is required, so a form will not submit while it is empty.

disabled.description: Shown and not changed: the box and both steppers are disabled, and the hidden input is not submitted.

readonly.description: Shown and not changed: the box is read-only, the steppers are disabled, the keys do not step.

invalid.description: The error state: the edge and the message take the error colour and the box carries aria-invalid.

error-message.description: The error shown in place of the hint while the field is invalid; slot `error` takes markup instead.

decrement-label.description: The accessible name of «−». Unset, it follows the page's language («Уменьшить значение», «Decrease value»).

increment-label.description: The accessible name of «+». Unset, it follows the page's language («Увеличить значение», «Increase value»).

aria-label.description: The spinbutton's accessible name when no label is drawn inside the field: a form that prints the label beside it (the Framework's field renderers) names the field without a second, visible label.

error.description: The error state; the same as invalid.

value.description: The number the field holds, written with a point (`2567.5`); empty for none. The property reads a number or null and takes a number, numeric text or null. Rounded to the field's digits. Set from code it fires nothing.

inherited-value.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no number of its own -- a default from a parent setting. Shown in the empty box in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a number of its own, a reset button returns it here.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

clear.summary: Empty the field from code; the same as setValue(null). Returns the element.

stepUp.summary: Move the value up by `count` steps (1 by default), held by the bounds, as a native field's stepUp(). Fires nothing. Returns the element.

stepDown.summary: Move the value down by `count` steps (1 by default), held by the bounds. Fires nothing. Returns the element.

setError.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid. Returns the element.

setValue.summary: Set the number from code: a number, numeric text with a point, or null for none. Rounded to the field's digits, not clamped. Fires nothing, as a value set from code is not a change. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Return the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: sf-field-reset first (cancellable), then input and change. Returns whether it reset.

getInputElement.summary: Returns the spinbutton's text box, or null before render.

change.summary: The value was committed: once per change the person made -- a commit of typed text (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper press (one for a whole held run), a key, a reset. A CustomEvent on the host; the box's own change does not leave the host. A commit that only rewrites the text fires nothing.

value.description: The number the field now holds; null when it is empty.

text.description: The number as the field writes it, in the page's language.

source.description: What made the change: typing in the box, a commit (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper, a key, or the reset back to the inherited value.

input.summary: The value moved: while typing, each time the text reads as a different number; on each step of a stepper or a key; before every change whose value it has not reported yet. Same detail as change.

value.description: The number the field now holds; null when it is empty.

text.description: The number as the field writes it, in the page's language.

source.description: What made the change: typing in the box, a commit (Enter or leaving the box), a stepper, a key, or the reset back to the inherited value.

sf-field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.description: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. Not prevented, the field empties, says so with input and change (source reset), shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset, written with a point.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: validation beyond the bounds, the step and the digits

accessibility.focus: One tab stop: the text box with role spinbutton, named by the label (aria-labelledby) or by aria-label, carrying aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext in the page's format, and described by the help or error. ArrowUp/ArrowDown step, PageUp/PageDown move ten steps, Home/End go to the bounds when there are bounds, Enter commits, Escape takes typing back. «−» and «+» are real buttons named «Уменьшить значение» / «Увеличить значение», out of the tab order as the APG pattern has them, controlling the box, disabled at the bounds; a pointer press does not take focus from the box. Pointer focus draws no ring, keyboard focus does.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-quantity for a form value that is a number a person adjusts by steps -- an amount, a count, an integer property -- with bounds and digits.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for a range picked by dragging: that is sf-range-slider
Do not read the box's text as the value: read value (a number or null) or the submitted form value
